title: Global Director of Manufacturing Engineering Services
text:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Creation Technologies is seeking a Director of Manufacturing Engineering Services to shape the future of engineering across our global manufacturing operations. This is an exciting opportunity to make an enterprise-wide impact by driving engineering strategy, advancing manufacturing capabilities, championing continuous improvement, and delivering innovative solutions within the dynamic Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) industry. This position offers the flexibility to work remotely while collaborating with talented engineering and operational teams across our global footprint. 
 
In this role, you will lead a diverse network of engineering leaders and technical professionals, transforming strategic vision into measurable business results. From advancing New Product Introduction (NPI) and Design for Excellence (DfX) initiatives to leveraging advanced analytics, emerging technologies, and best-in-class manufacturing practices, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening Creation’s engineering capabilities and delivering exceptional customer outcomes. If you thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are energized by solving complex challenges, building technical excellence, and driving meaningful organizational change, we want to hear from you!

**Responsibilities Include:**

 

* Provide global leadership for the Manufacturing Engineering Leaders and teams in development and execution of technology roadmaps
* Ownership and continuous improvement of global business processes including Configuration Management and Engineering Change Orders
* DfM capabilities including Valor DfM analysis, DfM Guidelines development, and best practices for the enterprise
* SMT, PTH, and Box Build/System Integration Routing Definitions, Assembly documents, and Work Instructions processes and tools 
 Procurement Specifications developed in conjunction with Customer and Supply Chain team members
* Product Lifecycle Management processes and tools
* Manage Product Environmental Compliance capabilities and requirements in conjunction with Customer and Quality Assurance team members
* Management of global supplier relationships with various Engineering service and software providers including related negotiations
* Manages the engineering software validation process for PLM, MES, DfX, NPI, Component Data Intelligence and other key applications 
 Works with all site and regional technical and business teams to develop, share, and implement best practices
* Represents the needs from the Manufacturing Engineering team to executive strategic, tactical, and operational

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and Required Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Computer, or Computer Science) is required
* Minimum of 15 years of related experience in a senior leadership and multi-site responsibility role
* Advanced degree in Engineering Management or Business Administration preferred
* Minimum of 10+ years’ experience in Electronics manufacturing of high-reliability PCBA sub-assemblies, assemblies, and system level products

**Skills Required:**

 

* Extensive applied manufacturing experience in Aerospace & Defense, Medical, and Tech Industrial products manufacturing (Highly preferred)
* Familiar with the product life development cycle for NPIs including Planning, Prototype, Qualification, and Ramp to sustaining volume production (Highly preferred)
* Proven analytical, problem-solving skills, and use of advanced statistical tools
* Strong technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to solve problems and clearly communicate topics of high technical content across various audiences including customers
* Demonstrated ability to identify & implement best practices
* Proven leadership and project management experience
* Excellent presentation skills and experience in customer relations
* Strategic thinker with a strong learning mindset and passion to support and grow a unique culture
* Thrives on the challenges of continuous improvement
* Driven by a high degree of integrity, with cultural and core value alignment to Creation
* Effective communication to interact effectively with all levels of the organization
* Entrepreneurial, creative and high-energy team player with the proven ability to balance competing priorities
* Deep knowledge of ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, FDA GMP Regulations, and Nadcap Process Certification

**Requirements:**

 

* Strong understanding of differences between IPC Class 1, 2 and 3 product build requirements.
* Knowledge of advanced Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles, tools, and methodologies
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt/Green Belt an asset 
 Engineering experience in printed circuit board or semiconductor manufacturing is a plus

In accordance with pay transparency regulations, the anticipated starting salary for this position ranges from $150k-$180k USD | CAD annually. Full-time employees are also eligible for performance-based bonuses and a range of benefits. Please note that this salary range is not guaranteed, and the final offer may vary based on experience, education, location, and shift. Additionally, the benefits and programs available may differ depending on the hire date, schedule type, and hours worked.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

Creation Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require any accommodations to complete the application process or need the job posting in an alternative format, please email Accessibility@creationtech.com. You will be connected with our Talent Acquisition team.

If you are contacted regarding the position, please inform our Talent Acquisition team of any accommodations you may need during the recruiting process. All information related to accommodation requests will be handled confidentially.
